text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Dozing off, I see an old memory dance
through my dreams.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On my way home from the amusement
park, I find a girl crying
because she got
separated from her mom.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Really?! Thanks, big bro! Hehe, you're so
nice. ♪

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Really?! Thanks, big sis! Hehe, you're so
nice. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her tears dry as we search, and then... as
we pass the park's princess
castle, she
stops and looks up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I follow the girl's gaze to the castle,
the question slips out of my mouth. In
response, she turns around and flashes me
a warm, mellow
smile.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Well, my dream is—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's morning, and I arrive in front of the
Tracen Academy school gates
to find a
huge crowd of people outside waiting for
something.

text_block_list.name: Trendy Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
No way—I think we managed to grab the
best spot here! We're like
super close!

text_block_list.name: Fangirl Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Waking up early to claim a spot was so
worth it! And If I'm lucky,
maybe I can get
a selfie...

text_block_list.name: Trendy Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?! Trainer, you're joking, right? Today's the day the famous Umastagrammer known only as "Curren" is transferring to our school!

text_block_list.name: Fangirl Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you really don't know?! We're
talking about the selfie goddess
with over
3 million followers on Umastagram—that
Curren!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems like this new transfer is already
well-loved by the student body. My
curiosity piqued,
I decide to wait with the crowd for her to
arrive.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Soon enough, a limousine parks in front of
the school gate, and a
single girl steps out.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Aiiieeeeek! Curren!

text_block_list.name: Curren?
text_block_list.text:
Wow! ♪ What a welcome! Don't tell me
you were all waiting for me?

text_block_list.name: Curren?
text_block_list.text: Hehe, you all are just the best!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You just made me the world's happiest
Curren Chan! ♪ Heehee! ♪

text_block_list.name: Trendy Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
No way! It's like Curren's got filters on
her—but in real life!

text_block_list.name: Trendy Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Omigosh—she's positively glowing! The Umastagram star, Curren, is really in front of me right now!

text_block_list.name: Fangirl Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Um, do you mind if I get a picture with
you? I'm your b-b-biggest fan!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Not at all! Let's see... Right, this pose will make you extra cute!

text_block_list.name: Fangirl Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Whoa,
I actually... got a pic with her. Wow!
Thank you so much! I'll
treasure this
forever!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren's happy when everyone's happy! ♪
When you post that pic,
don't forget to
spread the love via #CurrenChan!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Everyone,
there's still plenty of pictures to
be taken! ☆ Just remember
sure to share
the pics with all your friends, okay? ♪

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Okaaay! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What a presence...
I find myself staring at
the impromptu photoshoot,
lost for words,
when suddenly... my eyes meet Curren's.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Y-you're—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I'm talking to you, silly!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: After all... you and I are meant to be!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You're a trainer at this academy, aren't
you? I think... I was destined
to find you
here!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: It's decided—I've made up my mind! From today on... you'll be my trainer! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Is... that a no? You know,
I've been waiting
so long to see you... Sniff,
sniff...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her sudden barrage of cuteness nearly
sways me, but I return to my senses. A
contract between trainer and Umamusume
isn't something to
be taken lightly.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Okaaay! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Leaving the school gate behind, I take the
time to explain to Curren Chan about
trainers and how she shouldn't pick hers
off of a first
impression.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...A dream, huh?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course I do! ♪ After all,
I came to
this school...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...so I could hear everyone tell me how cute I am! ♪ I bet that at the Tracen Academy, I'll get waaay more followers!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It feels like someone just hit me over the head with a sledgehammer. That's why she enrolled here?!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hear me out, okay? I want even more
people to love me, and to do
that—I need
you!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
So, pleeease... Big Bro! Be my one and
only trainer! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
So, pleeease...
Big Sis! Be my one and only
trainer! ♪

text_block_list.name: Trendy Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Is that trainer actually trying to turn
down Curren? And when she's
asking so
earnestly, too...

text_block_list.name: Fangirl Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
If I were a trainer, I know I'd jump at an
opportunity like this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can feel her fans staring daggers at me
right now... I try to come up
with a good
reason to turn her down, but somehow...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Then from today on, you're my trainer!
We're official! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what did I just agree to?! She had
me in the palm of her hand!
I'd better
keep my guard up around her in the
future...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yay! ♪ Now we'll aaalways be together!
Isn't that great, Big Bro? ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yay! ♪ Now we'll aaalways be together!
Isn't that great, Big Sis? ♪

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Congratulations, Curren!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's a round of applause from the
nearby onlookers... but not
everyone
seems so keen to welcome the new arrival.

text_block_list.name: Serious Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...What's the deal with that crowd?

text_block_list.name: Race-loving Umamusume
text_block_list.text: An Umastagrammer... I hope she knows the rest of us are here to race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I guess popularity is a double-edged
sword. But at this academy, the
only way
to prove the doubters wrong is with your
race results.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Big Bro, are you worried about me?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Big Sis, are you worried about me?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, thanks. But it'll be okay—because
I'm suuuper cute! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day,
a physical evaluation is held
for Curren Chan. Surrounded by throngs of
curious spectators,
she shows off a variety of skills.

text_block_list.name: Instructor
text_block_list.text: 1,200 meters on dirt! A-at that speed!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our surroundings break out in commotion.
For a newbie, her time was
exceptional!
She might just have a natural talent for
sprinting.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Big Brooo! Hey hey, how did I do? I was
reeeally cute out there,
right? ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Big Siiis! Hey hey, how did I do? I was
reeeally cute out there,
right? ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan... Why did she transfer here,
and what does she want out
of racing? For
now, I hit the follow button on her
Umastagram profile.
